# AtomicSection { #timetoalign.timelines.AtomicSection }

```python
timelines.AtomicSection(name, start, end)
```

A stretch of the axis that flow control never divides.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name   | Type                                        | Description                                                                |
|--------|---------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| name   | [str](`str`)                                | Its letter: ``A``, ``B``, ... ``Z``, ``AA``, ... in the order of the axis. |
| start  | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) | Where it begins.                                                           |
| end    | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) | Where it ends, exclusive.                                                  |
